[[Halloween 2020 Event|Halloween 2020]] |first_wave_appearance = 14 (Originally) |tab_1 = Event |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,800 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Back from the Dead}}''' - Spawns numerous [[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Undead]], [[Bones (Trick or Threat Town)|Bones]], [[Mummy (Trick or Threat Town)|Mummy]], [[Hallow Bones]] and [[Buried]]. }}__TOC__ ==Description== The '''Reaper''' was a summoner enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. Currently, it only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had higher health compared to the [[Slime (Trick or Threat Town)|Slime]], but had lower health in comparison to the [[Reanimated]]. However, it had the same speed as the [[Reanimated]]. It could also spawn enemies, namely the [[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Undead]], [[Bones (Trick or Threat Town)|Bones]], [[Hallow Bones]] and [[Buried]]. ==Appearance== The '''Reaper''' is a faceless figure. The '''Reaper''' has white skin and a torn black cloak. It wears a black hood and had a chain across its torso. Its legs are marble grey and it wears a red belt across its waist. It wields a purple scythe to summon enemies with. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Trick or Threat Town]] is listed instead. *Splash damage towers are recommended against the '''Reaper''' to help manage the enemies that spawn. *High DPS towers are recommended against the '''Reaper'''. The [[Ranger]] and [[Minigunner]] are suitable towers for this. **It may be ideal for these towers to be set to ''Strongest'' to target the '''Reaper''' instead of the enemies that it spawns. **However, this may be an issue when higher health enemies appear at the same time as the '''Reaper''', like the [[Reanimated]]. *Try to defeat the '''Reaper''' before it crosses the bridge. **If it gets too close to the end of the map, it may spawn a [[Buried]] which could lead to a defeat. **If two '''Reapers''' are able to cross the bridge, they may summon enemies which could overpower your available towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseH20Reaper.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyReaperIconIG.png|'''Reaper''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy was similar to the 2019 version of the [[Reaper (Nightmare Carnival)|Reaper]]. *The '''Reaper's''' summon animation was same as the [[Molten Boss]]'s ''Scythe Slam''. **The '''Reaper's''' scythe was also the same as the [[Molten Boss]]'s scythe, except it was colored purple. ==Update History== * '''31 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1]] **'''Reaper''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3]] **'''Reaper''' removed. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **'''Reaper''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Reaper]]'s from [[Pizza Party]] [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. **{{Bug}} '''Reaper''' does not use its abilities. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TrickTown|[[Slime (Trick or Threat Town)|Slime]]|Wave 13|[[Hallow Bones]] & Reaper|Wave 14|[[Vampire (Trick or Threat Town)|Vampire]]|Wave 16}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Reaper}}
